title: Strict positivity of $R_\psi$ a.s. and reverse inclusion $\mu\ll T_\psi^*\mu$

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Sub-lemma (GAP 4).** Upgrade absolute continuity to **equivalence** (same null sets).

Two ingredients:
(a) **Strict positivity:** $R_\psi>0$ for $\mu$-a.e. $u$, and $R_\psi<\infty$ a.s. (exclude $R_\psi=+\infty$ on a positive-measure set). Positivity is formally automatic from the exponential form, but only after GAP 1 establishes a.s. finiteness of each Wick functional; this must be stated as a lemma, not assumed.
(b) **Reverse inclusion:** apply the GAP 3 identity with $\psi\mapsto-\psi$ to get $\mu=T_{-\psi}^*(T_\psi^*\mu)\ll T_\psi^*\mu$ with density $1/R_\psi$ (composed with the shift). Conclude $\mu\sim T_\psi^*\mu$.

**Deliverable.** The a.s. finiteness+positivity lemma and the symmetric-shift argument, with a clean null-set comparison concluding mutual absolute continuity.
